checks.text: The page displays the heading "Study Planner" and the tab buttons "Month" and "Week", with "Month" active by default.

Clicking the button "New session" opens a form; filling "Subject" with "Math", "Date" with "2024-05-15", "Start time" with "14:00", "Duration" with "60", and clicking "Save" adds a session to the calendar grid for May 15, 2024, displaying "Math 14:00-15:00".

Clicking the session "Math 14:00-15:00" on the calendar opens a detail view; clicking the button "Mark done" changes the session status to "Done" and displays a checkmark icon next to the session title.
In the session detail view, clicking the button "Delete" removes the session from the calendar; the grid for May 15, 2024, no longer displays "Math 14:00-15:00".
Switching to the "Week" tab displays a weekly grid; the session "Math 14:00-15:00" created on 2024-05-15 appears in the column for Monday, May 13, 2024, to Sunday, May 19, 2024.

Creating a session with "Subject" "History", "Date" "2024-05-16", "Start time" "10:00", "Duration" "90", and checking "Repeat weekly" creates a session on May 16 and automatically creates a recurring session on May 23, 2024, at 10:00-11:30.
The button "Export ICS" copies an ICS file content to the clipboard; the clipboard text contains "BEGIN:VEVENT" and "SUMMARY:Math".
The progress summary at the top shows "Completed: 1 of 2" after marking one of two sessions as done.
Reload keeps the session "Math 14:00-15:00" visible on the May 15, 2024, calendar grid and the progress summary "Completed: 1 of 2".
